map.输入液压缸尺寸、负载、速度要求，计算推/拉腔面积、所需压力与流量，设计回路压力与: From cylinder bore and rod diameter, load and required speed, calculate push/pull chamber areas, required pressure and flow to design circuit pressure and flow parameters.
map.💡 A₁=πD²/4，A₂=π(D²-d²)/4；推程压力 p₁=F·k/A₁，: 💡 A₁=πD²/4, A₂=π(D²-d²)/4; push pressure p₁=F·k/A₁, flow Q=A·v; pump pressure=p+Δp_pipe+back pressure
map.压力裕度系数考虑摩擦与制造误差，一般取 1.1~1.3: Pressure margin factor covers friction and manufacturing error, generally 1.1~1.3
map.杆径通常为缸径的 0.5~0.7 倍，受拉工况取大值: Rod diameter is usually 0.5~0.7 times the bore; use the larger value under tension
map.泵出口压力应留 1~2MPa 余量用于管路损失与阀口压降: Pump outlet pressure should keep 1~2 MPa margin for pipe loss and valve pressure drop
map.系统压力按标准系列选取：6.3/10/16/21/25/31.5MPa: System pressure follows the standard series: 6.3/10/16/21/25/31.5 MPa
map.📚 深度解析：液压回路速度与压力设计: 📚 In-depth: Hydraulic Circuit Speed and Pressure Design
map.按流量与缸面积算执行速度。: Compute actuator speed by flow and cylinder area.
map.压力与速度匹配负载节拍。: Match pressure and speed to the load cycle.
map.Q=80 L/min=1.33e-3 m³/s、A=0.004 ㎡ → v=Q/: Q=80 L/min=1.33e-3 m³/s, A=0.004 m² → v=Q/A≈0.33 m/s, stroke 0.3 m takes about 0.9 s.
map.负载 30 kN、A=0.004 → p=30e3/0.004=7.5 MPa，: Load 30 kN, A=0.004 → p=30e3/0.004=7.5 MPa; choose pump pressure plus pipe loss accordingly.
map.速度由流量定、压力由负载定，泵按二者最大值选，节流调速则互耦。: Speed is set by flow, pressure by load; the pump is sized by the larger of the two; throttle speed control couples them.
map.用同步阀或分流马达，或闭环反馈，否则负载差致速度偏。: Use a synchronizing valve or flow-divider motor, or closed-loop feedback; otherwise load difference causes speed deviation.
map.液压回路设计工具根据执行器（液压缸）尺寸、负载与速度要求，计算无杆腔与有杆腔有效: The hydraulic circuit design tool computes, from actuator (cylinder) size, load and speed, the effective areas of the bore and rod sides, the pressure and flow for extend/retract strokes, single-stroke time and hydraulic power, and gives recommended pump outlet pressure, pump flow and system pressure class to aid circuit pressure/flow design.
map.泵压力流量与系统等级推荐: Pump pressure/flow and system class recommendation
map.液压缸压力流量（本页代码口径）：无杆腔面积 A₁=πD²÷4、有杆腔 A₂=π(: Hydraulic cylinder pressure and flow (page code basis): cap-end area A₁ = πD²÷4, rod-end A₂ = π(D²−rod²)÷4 (mm²); required pressure = load F×pressure margin÷cap area (MPa), required flow = area×speed×60000 (L/min, the inverse of v=Q÷A), one-way time = stroke÷speed, hydraulic power = pressure×flow÷60 (kW), area ratio = A₁÷A₂; pump outlet pressure = cap-end pressure +1.5 MPa, pump flow = cap-end flow×1.1, recommended pressure rounded up to the 6.3/10/16/21/25/31.5/40 series. Validation: parameters must be valid numbers; bore/load/speed/stroke >0, 0≤rod<bore, margin >0, otherwise it prompts and stops. Verdict: rod-end pressure >1.5× cap-end pressure prompts checking back pressure in a differential circuit; rod diameter >0 and <0.4× bore prompts a stability check for a small rod.
